publication_name: HICP overall index, working day and seasonally adjusted
access_description: ECB Data Portal SDMX. No API key. CSV is requested with Accept: text/csv or format=csvdata. One monthly euro-area series.
conditions: Quote the source, for example "Source: ECB statistics.", and do not modify the statistics or their metadata. Use them in accordance with the ECB disclaimer. Do not use the ECB name or logo as an endorsement. The free-reuse grant does not cover third-party data. This row is only the ECB-compiled series ICP.M.U2.Y.000000.3.INX.
revision_behaviour: The SDMX response is the current series, not a historical vintage panel. The reuse policy states that statistics may be changed as a result of revisions or other updates. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero or interpolated.
unresolved_questions: The reuse policy does not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. One current download cannot reconstruct vintages from before they are collected.
evidence_note: The series response TITLE_COMPL states: Euro area (Member States and Institutions of the Euro Area) changing composition -  HICP - Overall index, Index, European Central Bank (ECB), Working day and seasonally adjusted. COMPILING_ORG and SOURCE_AGENCY are 4F0, European Central Bank (ECB). STS_INSTITUTION is 3, European Central Bank. This is not the Eurostat HICP (STS_INSTITUTION 4, compiling organisation 4D0). A non-persisting fetch of the current CSV on 2026-10-22 contained 348 monthly observations from 1997-01 to 2025-12, one value per month, with no gaps. It is not a historical vintage panel. The stored class is latest-revised. The reuse policy allows commercial and non-commercial reuse of ESCB statistics when the source is cited and the figures are not modified, and it does not cover third-party data. The policy does not name AI processing or model training. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. Assessed 2026-10-22.
